### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Restrict content to patient-reported symptoms and statements only. Do not include provider observations or exam findings.
[P]: Ensure all follow-up details, including purpose, are explicitly stated by the provider. Avoid inferring unstated reasons or potential adjustments.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[P]: State only the explicitly mentioned purpose for follow-up appointments. Do not infer or add potential future actions or adjustments not directly stated by the provider.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Report *only* symptoms and statements *explicitly* articulated by the patient. *Never* include provider observations or exam findings, even if they describe the absence of a condition (e.g., "no rash," "no jaundice").
